ask: Every surface looked at, very intrusive and aggressive, to ensure everything is consistent.
method: 2 parallel read-only Explore agents inventoried component-grammar adoption across all 13 surface groups + admin; findings hand-verified; the highest-value mechanical gap fixed by a guarded codemod.

headline_finding.before: 65/148 tables (43.9%) carried the canonical .rmc-data-table; the rest rendered raw Bootstrap so the SAME list looked premium on one surface and plain on another.

applied.rule: For every <table> already carrying `table-family` (the operational-data-table marker) but missing `rmc-data-table`, add the additive CSS-only `rmc-data-table` class. Behaviour classes (data-rmc-row-detail/bulk) untouched, so no behaviour change.
applied.excluded: templates/reports/* (PDF/print domain with bespoke cameroon-*/cam table classes — rmc-data-table would fight print layout); tables without table-family (bare/layout/print — judgment needed).
applied.result: 202 tables across 149 files now unified on .rmc-data-table — operator (schools/super_*, siteconfig partials), finance (dashboard/reports/trial_balance/invoice_detail/split_allocation/...), analytics, accounts, portal pockets, communication.
applied.safety: .rmc-data-table is additive styling (density/hover/tabular-nums); it imposes no overflow/min-width, and the patched tables remain inside their existing table-responsive wrappers — no layout regression.

validation.note: scan_undefined_css_classes shows 11 PRE-EXISTING findings — all cockpit _activity_ticker_* / _operator_incident_banner partials from the SEPARATE in-progress wave (313-file modified tree), NONE from this sweep (rmc-data-table is defined). Flagged, not mine to fix (would mean defining styles for another author's half-built components).
validation.off_token_theme_locked_inline_style: unaffected (HTML-only class add, no CSS color changes)

remaining_consistency_debt_flagged_not_a.finding: ~230 pages render bespoke <h1> instead of studio_os/components/page_header.html — the most visible cross-surface inconsistency.
remaining_consistency_debt_flagged_not_a.why_flagged: Migrating to the shared header changes H1 semantics + each page passes title/subtitle/action context; high blast radius, needs per-page review (some pages intentionally use visually-hidden H1 for a11y). Recommended as a dedicated header-grammar wave with the shared component as the single source.

remaining_consistency_debt_flagged_not_a.finding: ~47 pages have >1 btn-primary in the main action zone (competing primaries); worst: parent/dashboard (5), siteconfig compliance_exports_body (7).
remaining_consistency_debt_flagged_not_a.why_flagged: Which button is THE primary is a per-page product judgment, not mechanical — demoting the wrong one harms the flow. Needs design owner per surface.

remaining_consistency_debt_flagged_not_a.finding: ~57 raw Bootstrap .card on dashboard/list surfaces where rest of platform uses .rmc-card (finance 14, teacher 9, portal 10).
remaining_consistency_debt_flagged_not_a.why_flagged: rmc-card changes elevation/padding/border — can shift layout; needs visual QA per surface. Mechanical-ish but riskier than the table class; recommended as a follow-up card-grammar codemod with screenshot diff.

remaining_consistency_debt_flagged_not_a.owner: Belongs to the in-progress cockpit-activity-ticker wave (not this audit). Needs the definitions added to rmc-class-grammar(-ext).css by that wave's owner.

principle: Shipped the one large mechanical consistency win that is provably safe (additive class, codemod-driven, validated). The remaining debt is real and inventoried with file:line, but each class needs per-page judgment or belongs to another author's in-flight work — flagged rather than blind-swept, per the isomorphic-enhancement / no-half-fake contract.
